reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism teaching interpretation: low plated body, organically embedded slender curved tube feet with primary/secondary gaps and restrained articulated surface rhythm. Colors, nominal0.07m span, simplified repeated plates and static pose are art choices. No exact microscopic plate or podium counts, internal water-vascular reconstruction, feeding/movement mechanism or named specimen replica claimed. Blunt flexible-looking tips and curved paths distinguish podia from rigid random spines.
